text:
sam: Quick sync — performance sprint check. Kernel work, continuous batching, and KV warmup. Post 1-line status, blockers, and any PR links. Trying to close milestones this week.

alisa: Kernel PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4823. Needs a kernel fallthrough fix; CI flaky on macroprefetch test. ETA merge -> Thu EOD if reviews land. @raj PTAL.

raj: On it. I saw the macroprefetch flake; failing assert in kv_eviction_test. Suspect race in eviction timer. I'll push a small fix and re-run tests by 21:30 PT.

maria: Continuous batching canary is green for throughput, p50/p95 improved. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/team/runtime/d/abc123/canary-batching. p99 improved ~12% at seq=512 but we see CPU jitter when burst spikes hit the batching window. Investigating window tuning + backpressure.

taylor: KV warmup rollout blocked by infra change: infra-prefetch-lib needs ABI bump. Blocking issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/999 — owner @kevin. We can't advance the canary until infra publishes the new wheel.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime-canary/v1.12.3 -> canary pool. See deploy link: https://deploys.redwood/runtime/12345 (automated).

sam: Action items: 1) @raj push CI fix and mark PR when green. 2) @alisa add perf reviewer and run load scripts. 3) @taylor follow up with infra @kevin and attach the blocking issue to the sprint ticket. I updated the sprint board: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/SPRINT-128.

raj: Pushed small race fix, kicked off CI: https://ci.redwood/reports/4823. Tests currently running (kv_eviction_test rerun).

alisa: Added @maria as reviewer and left notes to run the 100k-token test harness. Also added a quick local reproduce command:

```
python -m perf.run --model=llama-13b --seq=1024 --batch=4 --iters=5000
```

maria: I'll run the 100k token load tomorrow 08:00 PT and post results here. If p99 holds, I can sign off on batching changes.

sam: Cool. If any PR or infra blocker remains by EOD, paste a 1-line status here (blocker + owner). Otherwise we'll do a 15-min sync tomorrow 11:00 PT to close milestones.

taylor: Pinged @kevin in the issue — he replied that the new wheel will be published by EOD. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks all — closing the loop. :rocket:
